issue_body:
need to make the chat template model dependent as `lab generate` can use different models
`ilab` serve and config (init) code should be model-dependent
there are parts of the model `serve` and `config` code that are hard coded for a single model type. Serve and Chat need to be able to handle any model vareity, namely `Q4_K_M` Mixtral variant to begin.

This issue is to track serve and config code that needs to change in order to handle this. 

relates to #851
